newsitem.title: RUSSIA: City of Moscow confirms issue of $500 mln Eurobond.
newsitem.headline: City of Moscow confirms issue of $500 mln Eurobond.

text.p: The City of Moscow will issue a $500 million Eurobond in the autumn with a probable maturity of five to 10 years, a city official said on Thursday.
"We are planning the second borrowing in mid-autumn," Sergei Pakhomov, first deputy head of the municipal borrowing department, told Reuters.
"We asked the banks we have invited to be lead-managers to give us quotes on the assumption that the volume of borrowing will be $500 million and for five-seven-10 years."
He said the paper would most likely be dollar-denominated.
Earlier a Moscow government source said the issue would be at the end of September or start of October.
Pakhomov said Moscow would choose two lead-managers. He said the city had already received 25 applicatations for lead-manager.
Moscow's debut $500 million was led by CS First Boston and Nomura International.
